title: Sort Transformed Array
description:
Given a sorted integer array nums and three integers a, b and c, apply a quadratic function of the form f(x) = ax2 + bx + c to each element nums[i] in the array, and return the array in a sorted order.
 
Example 1:
Input: nums = [-4,-2,2,4], a = 1, b = 3, c = 5
Output: [3,9,15,33]
Example 2:
Input: nums = [-4,-2,2,4], a = -1, b = 3, c = 5
Output: [-23,-5,1,7]

 
Constraints:

1 <= nums.length <= 200
-100 <= nums[i], a, b, c <= 100
nums is sorted in ascending order.

 
Follow up: Could you solve it in O(n) time?

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(nums=[-4, -2, 2, 4], a=1, b=3, c=5) == [3, 9, 15, 33]
    assert candidate(nums=[-4, -2, 2, 4], a=-1, b=3, c=5) == [-23, -5, 1, 7]
    assert candidate(nums=[-4, -2, 2, 4], a=0, b=3, c=5) == [-7, -1, 11, 17]
    assert candidate(nums=[-3, -1, 0, 1], a=1, b=0, c=0) == [0, 1, 1, 9]
    assert candidate(nums=[-3, -1, 0, 1], a=-1, b=0, c=0) == [-9, -1, -1, 0]
    assert candidate(nums=[1, 2, 3], a=2, b=-3, c=1) == [0, 3, 10]
    assert candidate(nums=[-2, 0, 2], a=1, b=-2, c=1) == [1, 1, 9]
    assert candidate(nums=[-2, -1, 1, 2], a=-2, b=4, c=-1) == [-17, -7, -1, 1]
